verdict.rationale: Webhook event subscriptions are a fair question for a cloud platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The only nearby items are cost alerts ('configure alerts based on your actual cost') and outage notifications ('Get notified of outages'), and neither describes webhook delivery to a programmatic consumer. Those are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
